name: Aminuddin Harun
_note: M2 state-executive cohort (Phase 2). Menteri Besar of Negeri Sembilan since 2018 (reappointed after Aug 2023). Added as a PH-aligned executive to balance the class. Provisional Layer B anchors pending the blind panel (minCodersToScore=3). Citations search-corroborated; reconfirm against primary sources. 3R DISCIPLINE: B3, B4 and B5 left unscored because his most prominent 2026 episodes (the attempted removal of the Yang di-Pertuan Besar; the minority-to-majority government reclassification) are royalty-adjacent or not policy U-turns, and the higher 3R bar means a live royal-succession dispute is not scored even where his conduct upheld constitutional process.

metrics.justification: No corruption charge, probe, or court matter against Aminuddin personally is on record; a 2020 allegation concerned his son, which he denied and which is not the subject's own status. Recorded as the subject's own status: none on record.

metrics.justification: During the November-December 2024 monsoon floods he directed the state to cancel its official New Year's Eve celebrations in solidarity with victims, was involved in aid distribution in Kuala Pilah, and ordered the drainage department to investigate recurrent flash-flood causes. A documented response with mixed outcomes (anchor 2).

metrics.justification: Negeri Sembilan recorded a state-record RM19.1 billion in approved investments in 2025 across 295 projects (up 164% on 2024 and beating its RM10 billion target), anchored on the Malaysia Vision Valley 2.0 corridor, and reported over 26,548 affordable homes developed since 2018. Delivered, measurable outcomes (anchor 3).
